verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own batch capability for transactional email: up to 1000 personalized email versions in a single API request, with idempotency keys for batch requests. It also says contact lists can be imported and updated programmatically. Bulk operations are clearly evidenced only for email sending, and the contact import/update claim is thin, so the broader 'many items at once' story is only partly covered. missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete across contacts, campaigns and other object types, explicit batch-size or limit details beyond email sends, evidence that bulk operations are exposed through the MCP/AI-assistant path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
